annotations.note: LMKDC FY25 rev TRY 8.73bn, EBITDA TRY 3.08bn; Group bond XS2862382541 ($690m 9.75% Jul-29) affirmed B+ Stable.
Fitch affirmed Limak Cement at B+ Stable in early 2026; company operating under Sustainable Fitch-verified Sustainability-Linked Finance Framework.
Producer is positioned in the bottom quartile (Q1) of global production costs, preserving positive EBITDA generation across cyclical commodity troughs.
>75% of revenues billed in USD/EUR against predominantly local-currency operating expenditures, creating a structural natural FX hedge.
Controls world-class mineral or petrochemical reserves essential to the domestic economy, ensuring sovereign backstop support in stress scenarios.

verdict.stance: Neutral / Resilient Eastern Anatolia Reconstruction Demand (B+ Stable Fitch)
verdict.summary: Fitch affirmed Limak Cement and its $690m 9.75% Jul-29 Eurobond (XS2862382541) at B+ Stable (RR4), expecting gross leverage to remain <3.5x post-$115m tap despite ~78% USD-linked cost structure. Listed core subsidiary LMKDC generated TRY 8.73bn revenue and TRY 3.08bn EBITDA in FY25.

positives: Fitch affirmed Long-Term IDR at 'B+' Stable in early 2026.
Diversified regional plant footprint (including eastern/southeastern Anatolia) plus export optionality.
Established Sustainability-Linked Finance Framework (Sustainable Fitch SPO) supporting green capex funding.
negatives: Exposure to Turkish macroeconomic tightening, domestic housing slowdown, and TRY inflation.
Energy/fuel cost volatility (electricity & petcoke) and decarbonization capex requirements through 2030.

background.ownership_governance: Part of Limak Holding; maintains ICMA-aligned Sustainable Finance Framework.
